module.name: Greenhollow Vale
module.description: Installed situations share this persistent world.

entities.name: Halden, keeper of the roadside house
Travel the raised road to the outlying settlement
Travel the raised road to the town
Veyra, Keeper of the Last Road
Root marks reveal a drain from the lower vault to the towpath.
The store threshold releases preservative dust; pin or brace its shutter, or accept its exposure.
The founders obligated this shelter to receive travelers without requiring membership in their order.

actions.name: Travel to {destination}
actions.report: You follow the route and arrive at the next place. People and dangers continue while you travel.

actions.name: Give {recipient} one coin
actions.report: You hand over one coin. It is now in the recipient’s purse.

actions.name: Give {recipient} one ration
actions.report: You offer a ration and step back. The recipient now owns it; what they do next is their decision.

actions.name: Eat a ration
actions.report: The company shares a ration. This satisfies hunger but does not restore health or mana.

actions.name: Collect one {goods} from {store}
actions.report: You collect one unit from the available stock. It is now carried by the company.

actions.name: Deposit one {goods} in {store}
actions.report: You deposit what the company was carrying. The stock increases and your hands are free.

actions.name: Tell {recipient}: {statement}
actions.report: You explain what the evidence establishes. The listener accepts your account and sets aside a conflicting assumption; their next choices remain their own.

actions.name: Ask {informant} about {topic}
actions.description: Ask about an offered topic. The speaker shares an established fact they actually know.
actions.report: The speaker shares an account they know. You record it in your journal.

actions.name: Destroy {witness}
actions.report: You destroy this source of evidence. Existing knowledge and other sources remain.

actions.name: Take the key for {device} from {keeper}
actions.description: Recover access from an incapacitated keeper here. You must still operate the mechanism yourself.
actions.report: You recover the keeper’s key. You can now operate the mechanism; it has not opened by itself.

actions.name: Pledge support to {recipient}
actions.description: Publicly put your name behind this person's claim.

actions.name: Disable {device}
actions.description: Dismantle an accessible mechanism you are equipped to work on. The change persists.
actions.report: You dismantle the operating mechanism. It stops; any earlier damage remains.

actions.name: Close {device}
actions.description: Close the passage this mechanism controls. People already inside can leave.
actions.report: You close the barrier. People already beyond it can leave.

actions.name: Open {device}
actions.description: Reopen the physical passage. This does not make the place beyond it safe.
actions.report: You open the barrier. The passage beyond is now available, though it may still be dangerous.

actions.name: Follow the concealed passage to {destination}
actions.report: You follow the route you learned about and emerge beyond the obstruction.

actions.name: Request passage from {keeper} as {identity}
actions.description: Invoke a company identity this keeper has explicitly agreed to honor. This is not general persuasion.
actions.report: You invoke the compact. The keeper honors your company’s standing and grants passage.

actions.name: Approach {animal} using {skill}
actions.description: Read the signals of an explicitly receptive animal and pass without provoking it. Hostile animals cannot be approached this way.
actions.report: You read the animal’s signals and approach without provoking it. The guarded route is now available.

actions.name: Have {caster} use {technique} on {recipient}
actions.description: Use a known healing or cleansing ability outside combat. Its normal mana cost is paid; combat cooldowns do not apply.
actions.report: You pause to tend a companion. The same spell effects and mana costs apply here as in battle.

actions.name: Rest and recover at {site}
actions.description: Spend six hours and one shared ration at a safe shelter. Living companions recover HP and mana; bleeding is treated. Poison and death remain. Other people and deadlines continue.
actions.report: You settle in for six hours, sharing a ration and tending your wounds. The world continues outside.

actions.name: Accept {gift} for {recipient}
actions.report: The chosen companion studies the one-use lesson. Its power is spent, but the learned ability remains available on future expeditions.

actions.name: Buy one {goods} from {merchant} for two coins
actions.description: Trade two coins for one unit from a present merchant's finite stock. This is a posted price, not a negotiation simulation.
actions.report: You pay two coins and receive one unit of supplies. The merchant's stock and both purses change accordingly.

actions.name: Recover a coin from {store}
actions.report: You recover one coin from the finite cache. It is now in the company's purse.

actions.name: Collect {find} for {recipient}
actions.report: The item is now carried by the chosen companion. It will remain with them between expeditions.

actions.name: Buy {find} for {recipient}
actions.report: You pay the posted price and take possession of the item. This finite stock is not replaced when you return.

actions.name: Equip {tool} on {wearer}
actions.report: The companion equips the item. Another item in the same slot is put away; generated characteristics stay unchanged.

actions.name: Use {dose} on {recipient}
actions.report: The single dose is spent. Its effects resolve on the chosen companion.

actions.name: Give {cargo} to {recipient}
actions.report: The companion takes the item and packs it away. Equipment can also be recovered from fallen companions.

actions.name: Set down {cargo}
actions.report: You leave the object here. Its position persists until somebody moves it.

actions.name: Train {student} in {lesson}
actions.report: An hour of instruction spends 20 earned experience. The learned technique remains available on future expeditions.

actions.name: Deliver {cargo} to {buyer} for six coins
actions.report: The buyer takes actual possession of the commissioned object and pays six coins from their finite purse. The company no longer carries it.

actions.name: Gather an edible ration from {patch}
actions.report: Your woodcraft specialist gathers a shared ration from the identified edible patch. The finite patch is reduced; it does not replenish when you revisit.

actions.name: Risk {trap} toward {destination}; {victim} leads
actions.report: The leading companion tests the dangerous crossing. Its mechanism discharges once; the injuries and spent mechanism remain.

actions.name: Cross the spent {trap} toward {destination}
actions.report: You cross the now-spent mechanism. It will not rearm when you return.

actions.name: Disarm {trap}
actions.report: Your delving specialist identifies the warned release and pins it safely. The spent mechanism stays disabled.

actions.name: Brace {trap} with {kit}
actions.report: Following the warning, you pin and brace the moving parts with the climbing kit. This crossing remains safe. The reusable kit stays with its bearer.

actions.name: Climb to {destination} using {kit}
actions.report: The company anchors its line and climbs together. The kit opens this route without changing the underlying geography.

actions.name: Shift {device} to free {companion}
actions.report: You lever the obstruction aside. The trapped person is free, but still needs a safe route home.

actions.name: Escort {companion} to {destination}
actions.report: You travel together. Your companion remains at the actual destination; no one teleports home.

actions.name: Present the register and custody writ to {keeper}
actions.report: The keeper checks the named record and your custody writ. It allows passage under that authority. It remains alive, and the dead have not become ownerless loot.

actions.name: Open {door}
actions.report: You open the door. The threshold is now passable from either side.

actions.name: Close {door}
actions.report: You close the door. It remains unlocked.

actions.name: Unlock {door} with {key}
actions.report: The carried key turns in the lock. The door is unlocked but still closed; the key stays with its owner.

actions.name: Pick the lock on {door}
actions.report: The delver works the simple lock open. This takes half an hour and does not open the door itself.

actions.name: Read the signs of {life}
actions.description: A living woodcraft specialist identifies an authored species from signs in its declared habitat. This is identification, not a simulation of an ecosystem.
actions.report: Your trail-wise companion identifies the species from its signs. Suitable resources here can now be gathered carefully.

actions.name: Gather {herb} for {recipient}
actions.description: Collect a finite, authored herbal preparation. It does not regrow merely because you leave.
actions.report: You gather and dress the usable stems into one poultice. The patch is depleted; its preparation is now a real, single-use carried item.

actions.name: Have {caster} ward {recipient} with {technique}
actions.description: Prepare a persistent protective ward before entering danger. Normal mana is paid; duration counts owner-combat-turn boundaries rather than travel time.
actions.report: The companion prepares a protective ward. Its normal mana cost is paid, its source is recorded, and it persists into the next encounter.

actions.name: Keep the observance at {altar} for {recipient}
actions.description: A companion versed in burial lore leads Veyra's observance. Spend one shared ration as hospitality. This shrine grants its blessing once per company: +2 to saves, for three owner-combat-turn boundaries. Travel does not consume it. It cannot stack with another shrine's identical blessing.
actions.report: You share food in the Keeper's name. A wayfarer's protection settles on the chosen companion; its source and remaining combat lifetime persist.

actions.name: Ask about the fallen rack and the cellar key
actions.description: Speak with someone here about an offered topic.
actions.report: 'Tamsin came to compare her seeds with the old register. A rack fell while she was below. The brass key is on my counter; take it and unlock the cellar. A delver can work the lock too, but do not mistake an unlocked door for an open one. Bring her up with you. The archive below is older than this shop, and something has nested there.'
actions.speaker: world__apothecary

actions.name: Ask why the travelers' hall is closed
actions.description: Speak with someone here about an offered topic.
actions.report: 'We have little food. I admit only our congregation. I swore to follow the founders, not every stranger's wish. Their charter is here. If it says otherwise, show it to me. The wayfarer stone is open to a company who knows Veyra's observance.'
actions.speaker: world__host

actions.name: Ask what the archive holds
actions.description: Speak with someone here about an offered topic.
actions.report: 'The old families kept seeds and travelers' names there. A cave hound can be avoided: do not attack it if you only want the register room's relic. Search the root marks for an old drain. We cannot simulate sneaking; simply entering its room does not start a battle. Fighting is your decision.'
actions.speaker: world__apothecary

actions.report: 'The load shifted and caught me. The obstruction can be levered aside. After that I need company along an actual safe route home; I cannot follow you if you simply walk away.'

actions.description: Speak with someone here about an offered topic.
actions.report: 'I can walk now. Escort me along the open ways, one place at a time. I will wait here if you go on without me.'

actions.name: Speak with the traveler after returning
actions.description: Speak with someone here about an offered topic.
actions.report: 'You came back with me instead of just shifting the debris. I will remember that.' The journey home is a lasting fact, not the end of the campaign.

actions.name: Ask why the shelter is closed
actions.description: Speak with someone here about an offered topic.
actions.report: 'I keep the founders' obligation, not a private inn. I thought their hospitality was reserved for members of our order. Read the charter here. If I have misunderstood it, tell me what it actually says.'
actions.speaker: world__host

actions.description: Speak with someone here about an offered topic.
actions.report: 'The founders required hospitality beyond our order. I was wrong to refuse it. The shelter is open; that does not make me the owner of your choices.'

observations.text: Hearthleaf's painted mortar hangs over a shop door. To one side stands Veyra's roadside house; the river road leads out toward the ferry hamlet. A drying rack has fallen below the apothecary. The shopkeeper needs help, while the refuge keeper has stopped admitting travelers.
The air smells of cut herbs. A brass key and a bottled draught sit on the counter. Below the ironbound door, someone strikes the cellar ceiling. Speak to the apothecary before you descend.

Drying frames have collapsed across a seed carrier's legs. The stair returns to the shop; the dry store leads deeper. The rack can be shifted without attacking anyone. Scored stone warns of a dust shutter at the dry-store threshold. Search before crossing; a delver can disarm it, or a leading companion can risk its discharge.
The fallen frames have been levered aside. The seed carrier can travel, but will stay here until you choose to escort her through each exit.
Salt jars stand on dry shelves. A worn stone stair descends into an older level, the pilgrims' archive. You can turn back before risking its inhabited vault.

Roots have broken the seed-register shelves. A pale cave hound watches from a niche. A relic remains by the register. Search the room's root marks for another route; no battle starts merely because you entered.
The cave hound is dead. The broken shelves, remaining relics and root-cut stone persist. Its defeat has not repaired the archive.
A narrow masonry drain curves toward daylight. Its upper mouth emerges beside the towpath, providing a second way back into the lower halls.

A weathered charter hangs beside Veyra's wayfarer stone. The keeper waits by the inner hall. Sharing food in the Keeper's observance grants a limited ward; it does not restore the dead or make this place safe by decree.
Travelers' pallets surround a common hearth. Admission has changed because the keeper accepted the charter. A ration and six hours here will restore living companions, not undo death or poison.
Floodwater cuts the raised road. Reach the outlying settlement by the habitat path instead: the living geography changes the available journey, not merely the place names.
A fallen bank cuts the woodland-to-waystation trail. The raised road leaves directly from town; the woodland track is an optional side journey.

The towpath passes an alder-lined bank and open woodland. Broken stems and animal tracks can be identified by a woodcraft specialist. A yarrow patch can yield one usable preparation. The animal trail loops into a clearing; the ferry road continues onward.
A territorial animal holds the clearing. A woodcraft specialist can read its receptive signals, or the company can choose violence. The path back remains open.
A covered waiting room gives travelers a safe place to recover. This hamlet belongs to the same region; traveling here does not reload the town or its situations.
Rain has made the low onward crossing impassable. You can still return to town or use the discovered drain. The cutoff remains after leaving and reloading.

Heavy rain now pools around the shop threshold. The household still bears whatever injuries, losses and obligations your expedition left behind. Rain is a reported pressure here; it does not secretly flood rooms or invent damage.
A traveler is pinned beneath a fallen obstruction. You can reach and speak to them. Moving the weight will free them; escorting them to safety will still require a traversable route.
The obstruction has been shifted. The traveler is free and waiting here. They will not teleport home or follow a company that leaves without escorting them.
The rescued traveler has reached safety and remains here. The place where they were trapped stays changed.
The keeper has drawn the shelter bolt. The founding charter is available to read. Reading it does not tell the keeper what you found; explain its obligation if the keeper trusts your report.
The shelter is open. The forecourt still leads outside; entering does not close the institution behind you.
The shelter's interior is accessible. Access and recovery are separate: this package does not create beds, supplies or a recovery service.

schemas.name: Cross the spent {trap} toward {destination}
schemas.report: You cross the now-spent mechanism. It will not rearm when you return.

schemas.name: Disarm {trap}
schemas.report: Your delving specialist identifies the warned release and pins it safely. The spent mechanism stays disabled.

schemas.name: Brace {trap} with {kit}
schemas.report: Following the warning, you pin and brace the moving parts with the climbing kit. This crossing remains safe. The reusable kit stays with its bearer.

schemas.name: Climb to {destination} using {kit}
schemas.report: The company anchors its line and climbs together. The kit opens this route without changing the underlying geography.

schemas.name: Shift {device} to free {companion}
schemas.report: You lever the obstruction aside. The trapped person is free, but still needs a safe route home.

schemas.name: Escort {companion} to {destination}
schemas.report: You travel together. Your companion remains at the actual destination; no one teleports home.

schemas.name: Present the register and custody writ to {keeper}
schemas.report: The keeper checks the named record and your custody writ. It allows passage under that authority. It remains alive, and the dead have not become ownerless loot.

schemas.name: Open {door}
schemas.report: You open the door. The threshold is now passable from either side.

schemas.name: Close {door}
schemas.report: You close the door. It remains unlocked.

schemas.name: Unlock {door} with {key}
schemas.report: The carried key turns in the lock. The door is unlocked but still closed; the key stays with its owner.

schemas.name: Pick the lock on {door}
schemas.report: The delver works the simple lock open. This takes half an hour and does not open the door itself.

schemas.name: Read the signs of {life}
schemas.description: A living woodcraft specialist identifies an authored species from signs in its declared habitat. This is identification, not a simulation of an ecosystem.
schemas.report: Your trail-wise companion identifies the species from its signs. Suitable resources here can now be gathered carefully.

schemas.name: Gather {herb} for {recipient}
schemas.description: Collect a finite, authored herbal preparation. It does not regrow merely because you leave.
schemas.report: You gather and dress the usable stems into one poultice. The patch is depleted; its preparation is now a real, single-use carried item.

schemas.name: Have {caster} ward {recipient} with {technique}
schemas.description: Prepare a persistent protective ward before entering danger. Normal mana is paid; duration counts owner-combat-turn boundaries rather than travel time.
schemas.report: The companion prepares a protective ward. Its normal mana cost is paid, its source is recorded, and it persists into the next encounter.

schemas.name: Keep the observance at {altar} for {recipient}
schemas.description: A companion versed in burial lore leads Veyra's observance. Spend one shared ration as hospitality. This shrine grants its blessing once per company: +2 to saves, for three owner-combat-turn boundaries. Travel does not consume it. It cannot stack with another shrine's identical blessing.
schemas.report: You share food in the Keeper's name. A wayfarer's protection settles on the chosen companion; its source and remaining combat lifetime persist.

installations.name: A House Above Older Halls: A house over older halls
installations.description: An apothecary's damaged cellar stands over a pilgrims' archive. Someone is trapped below; a keeper disputes the old refuge's purpose. Beyond the houses, tracks and medicinal plants follow the river and woodland. These are installed situations in a shared region, not stages of a quest.

installations.name: A traveler pinned beneath an obstruction: trapped-traveler
installations.description: A living traveler is trapped by a physical obstruction. Freeing them and getting them home are separate accomplishments; neither creates a route nor teleports the traveler.

installations.name: A keeper's mistaken reading of a founding obligation: founding-charter
installations.description: A keeper denies shelter under a mistaken understanding of an institution's founding charter. The charter is an objective source. Reading it changes the reader's knowledge; a trusted report can change the keeper's knowledge. This bounded package implements the keeper's existing commitment to honor that charter.
